Messages.Author: Jarrod P. Stenberg
Messages.Body:
Supposedly we should be posting our buying and trading offers on a
different newswatcher list. Nice idea for clarity, but I have a
suggestion:

We should allow such postings here, but insist that responses to the
initial post be carried on via e-mail.

My reasoning being that of all the card-related newswatchers out there,
Jyhad/V:TES card information occupies a marginal--very marginal--space
amidst all the other card games. It's easier for me, and I imagine most
of the other V:TES players to check one site for all V:TES news, rather
than hopping all over several lists looking for the one or two scattered
V:TES articles on each list.

Brian
sago...@maroon.tc.umn.edu

Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Matthew Sottile (msot...@uofport.edu) wrote:
: I would agree. Since there really isn't much in the way of numbers in this

: game as compared to, say, Magic, we don't need to worry about massive amounts
: of bandwidth in one group going away because of Trading/For Sale stuff.
: And I *DON'T* want to sift through 450 magic ads for maybe 5 VTES or Jyhad
: ones.

The newsgroup rec.games.traging-cards.marketplace.misc _should not_ have
MtG postings on it; it was specifically set up with a charter to allow
only non-MtG postings.

This newsgroup is a discussion group for Jyhad, not a marketplace group.
When the marketplace.misc group did not exist, people had some sympathy
and tolerance for those trying to make seen their (very) few non-MtG posts
in the original .marketplace group (99.5% of posts were Magic-related).
Now that the new group has been created, this sympathy seems to have
mostly dried up.
